cut: In src/commands/mod.rs, src/cli.rs, src/commands/check.rs, src/sources.rs, and src/commands/doctor.rs, replace the parallel failure vectors with one optional keyed JSON payload and share the constructor that appends indented diagnostics and serializes the items; in src/sources.rs, derive the lookup directory from the existing kind noun; in src/commands/doctor.rs, render each program from its name and check during the existing loop and use the existing entry lookup’s insertion fallback to remove the explicit match; in src/commands/tool.rs, destructure the sole action in run and inline its single-use show function; in src/machine.rs, quote the joined field names directly instead of allocating a vector of individually quoted strings.
answer: Made every cut: Failure carries one list: Option<(key, Value)> built by Failure::listing (used by check, read_role and doctor); Kind derives its directory from its noun; doctor renders each program in the loop and inserts the entry then finds it; tool show is inlined into run with a let-destructure; put_command joins the quoted fields directly. Still 351 net lines: two new commands, the machine module and their tests.
